entities.name: Mecca
entities.how_described: 本集说它是为机器人打造的「数据和部署公司」：设计采集硬件、组织全球个人与企业贡献者、清洗并授权训练机器人基础模型所需的数据。

evidence.quote: Today I'm delighted to have Josh from Mecca on the show.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

evidence.quote: Josh is founder and CEO of Mecca AI, which is building a data and deployment company for robotics.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

evidence.quote: Maybe to start off, for those who aren't familiar, what is Mecca and how are you looking to impact the world of robotics?
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

evidence.quote: So Mecca is, like you said, the data and deployment company for Physically High.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And I can imagine a Mecca competitor comes to Sonya and says, Sonya, I really want your podcast data.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

evidence.quote: When we do get there, the thing is, I believe that Mecca will look very different along that process.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: We see Mecca maturing into that.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: A joke that we make in some of our all hands in the company would be if one day Mecca was able to help deploy a robot that mines an asteroid, we've probably done a pretty good job.

entities.name: 数据工厂 (data factory)
entities.how_described: 本集用它形容 Mecca 的商业模式：以消费者 App 和 B2B 签约两条路采集数据，背后是自研硬件分发、100 GB 上传专线和数百 PB 数据的质量门控运营。

evidence.quote: Your position in the ecosystem as the leading data factory to bring robotic data and physical data in distribution for models is just a really, really interesting perch.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

evidence.quote: So I'm excited to use this conversation today to chat about how does egocentric data and data collection work in robotics, what are the actual operations and economics of operating a data factory, and your overall thoughts on robotics research and deployment.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

evidence.quote: I'd love to just spend a bit of time on the actual operations of a data factory because I think there's so much money that's gone into the LLM data factories.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

evidence.quote: But the actual data engine for the data factory is so much more sophisticated and much more painful than folks can expect.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: 自我中心数据 (egocentric data)
entities.how_described: 本集说它是人类以第一人称视角执行任务的视频数据，能弥合人类数据到机器人数据的视觉鸿沟，是 Mecca 当初押注的公司主线。

evidence.quote: So I'm excited to use this conversation today to chat about how does egocentric data and data collection work in robotics, what are the actual operations and economics of operating a data factory, and your overall thoughts on robotics research and deployment.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

evidence.quote: Maybe for our audience, just say a word on what is egocentric data?
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

evidence.quote: Obviously, it's much more distributed now, but what is egocentric data?
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

evidence.quote: Egocentric data is pretty much video data from humans demonstrating and doing tasks from a first person POV.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And so when you think about this egocentric data of podcasting as simply one of your SKUs, and you then realize that there is going to be different types of data that are going to be important, such as maybe we move from the Chinese restaurant from the side of the road.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: In that one, we're not fully subscribed to only egocentric data.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: Egoverse, so Professor Dan Fay, Ryan Simmer, these are some of the earliest cohorts of researchers that believed in egocentric data.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And so, one, we created and contributed a large amount of different types of egocentric data across different businesses, industries, home environments.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: Is it fair to say that the robotics industry has kind of converged on a training data mix that is, you know, internet scale data from YouTube and the like, plus a bunch of egocentric data, plus tele, UMI, and then plus tele-op, and like maybe there was like a triangle of like amount of data on each.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

evidence.quote: It's only egocentric data that's going to work.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And so to close that gap, a lot of the egocentric data today is to, one, help us ground the basic physics and the basic behavior cloning that you have to get to.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: 遥操作 (teleoperation)
entities.how_described: 本集说它是早期主流的机器人数据采集方式——人操控机器人做演示，但当时很难规模化，这正是 Mecca 转向人类数据的原因。

evidence.quote: A lot of what we saw was robotics data at the time was teleoperation, which was humans controlling robots to do demonstrations.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: There have been these very large scale robot factories that have spun up from just large scale warehouses, repetitively doing tasks, trying to scale up teleoperation data.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: Some tens of thousands of hours of UMI data, and then some last-mile teleoperation data and in-domain, in-distribution data in just a couple hours even of that demonstration.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: 力觉数据 (force data)
entities.how_described: 本集说视频拍不出拧瓶盖、拿鸡蛋用了多大力，力觉数据会极其重要，市面买不到可靠记录力的手套，Mecca 只能自研触觉手套来采集。

evidence.quote: How important is capturing force data and how do you think about getting that?
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

evidence.quote: I think some of the substitutes for force data that we've seen would be approaches like wrist cameras currently across both humans and robots and being able to see the contact time between the hand and the different objects that you interact with.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: I think force data will be incredibly important.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And so you combine that with like, you probably need force data and there's a way more, you know, it's just a way harder environment to operate in.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

entities.name: UMI 数据 (UMI data)
entities.how_described: 本集说机器人训练数据配方已收敛为：约百万小时人类多模态数据、数万小时 UMI 数据，再加少量末段遥操作和域内数据。

evidence.quote: We did UMI data.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: It's fun to see that even a year ago, many folks would argue and say, oh, no, it's only UMI data that's going to work.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: Some tens of thousands of hours of UMI data, and then some last-mile teleoperation data and in-domain, in-distribution data in just a couple hours even of that demonstration.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: 机器人基础模型 (robotics foundation models)
entities.how_described: 本集说它们是 Mecca 数据的下游客户：机器人领域从根本上受数据约束，需要像素、动作和逻辑三类数据来训练这些模型理解物理世界。

evidence.quote: What that means is today we create, we process, and ultimately we license a lot of the data that goes into training these robotics foundation models.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: There is nothing off the shelf that you can purchase and that you can wear and that reliably tells you how much force you are applying day to day and turn that into ready data sets for these different robotics foundation models.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: But some of these specialized models, some of these more targeted robotics foundation models might become very excellent into four nines of capability and reliability in some of these tasks.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: 世界模型 (world models)
entities.how_described: 本集说世界模型（现常与视频模型混用）能让人「想象」杯子摔碎而不必真的做，借助互联网像素预测可加速动作轨迹学习，但今天还没有能重现物理世界细节的世界模拟器。

evidence.quote: And we get to leverage all the work that has gone into the VLMs and then different types of world models before to make that possible.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: What are your thoughts on, I guess, what's happening with world models, which I guess are being used somewhat interchangeably with video models as a term right now, but world models and their contribution to the robot data training mix?
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

entities.name: Tesla
entities.how_described: 本集反复以 Tesla 为类比：用车队式学习采集自动驾驶数据，花十多年解决加速和方向两个自由度，积累的视频远超几百万小时。

evidence.quote: Why couldn't we turn humans into this fleet-style learning that Tesla has to be able to all contribute into understanding and ground the physics of the world?
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: But then comparatively, and you think about autonomous driving as an example, Tesla spent over a decade solving for two degrees of freedom ultimately, of acceleration and direction, millions of cars on the road.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: You mentioned Tesla and FSD earlier in this show.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

entities.name: 全模态模型 (omnimodel)
entities.how_described: 本集说很多模型正收敛到全模态方法：可输入力、像素甚至气味作为观测，输出动作、语音或控制信号。

evidence.quote: I like the approach, a lot of the models converging towards an omnimodel approach, and where you can feed it any type of input that is the observation, whether it is force, pixel, even smell in a very extreme case.
